# Phone Repair Near Me

> Independent directory of phone repair shops across Greater Sydney, NSW. Compare screen, battery, charging port, back glass, camera and water-damage repair options by suburb, with store distance, hours and contact details.

Phone Repair Near Me helps people in any Sydney suburb find the closest listed phone repair store, see indicative pricing and get directions or a phone number. The directory is independent of any phone manufacturer.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://phonerepairnearme.com.au/): overview and suburb search
- [All Sydney suburbs](https://phonerepairnearme.com.au/sydney/): full directory grouped by region (594 suburbs, 17 regions)
- [Repair services](https://phonerepairnearme.com.au/services/): screen, battery, charging port, back glass, camera, water damage
- [About](https://phonerepairnearme.com.au/about/)
- [List your shop](https://phonerepairnearme.com.au/list-your-shop/): for repair businesses that want to be listed
- [Full sitemap](https://phonerepairnearme.com.au/sitemap.xml): every suburb, region and service URL

## Notes
- Each suburb page (`https://phonerepairnearme.com.au/sydney/<suburb>/`) ranks the currently listed stores by straight-line distance from that suburb and shows live-computed opening hours.
- Store listings (name, address, phone, hours) are maintained directly by the site operator; only three physical stores are listed as of 2026-10-29, so distances on far suburb pages can be large — this is disclosed on the page itself.
- Suburb/region page copy is template-generated from a shared dataset; store details and pricing are not.
